info.name: Lists all external load balancers in the project and returns their details.

params.name: project_id
params.description: ID of the project that owns the external load balancers.

params.name: location
params.description: Filters results to external load balancers in this location.

params.name: vpc_network_id
params.description: Filters results to external load balancers in this VPC network.

params.name: name
params.description: Filters results to external load balancers with this name.

items.docs: Lists all external load balancers in the project and returns their details.

info.name: Creates an external load balancer in the project and returns the async operation.

params.name: project_id
params.description: The project ID to which the external load balancer belongs.

items.docs: This endpoint creates a new external load balancer in the specified project. The request must include the VPC ID, name, location, and at least one listen port with its associated backends.

info.name: Returns details for a single external load balancer in the project.

params.name: project_id
params.description: ID of the project that owns the external load balancer.

params.name: load_balancer_id
params.description: ID of the external load balancer.

items.docs: Returns details for a single external load balancer in the project.

info.name: Updates an external load balancer in the project and returns the async operation.

params.name: project_id
params.description: The project ID to which the external load balancer belongs.

params.name: load_balancer_id
params.description: The ID of the external load balancer to update.

items.docs: This endpoint updates the configuration of an existing external load balancer. The request must include the load balancer ID and optionally the health check options and/or listen ports and associated backends.

info.name: Deletes an external load balancer from the project and returns the async operation.

params.name: project_id
params.description: The project ID to which the external load balancer belongs.

params.name: load_balancer_id
params.description: The ID of the external load balancer to delete.

items.docs: This endpoint deletes an external load balancer identified by its ID within the specified project. No request body or query parameters are required.
